blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Photos of Cale88 Foods Corp.’s facilities taken during an online evaluation of the Department of Trade and Industry’s (DTI) Board of Investments (BOI) were presented before the Senate impeachment court on Friday. On Day 45 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, Ceferino Rodolfo, DTI undersecretary for the Industry Development and Promotions Group, testified that Cale88 is registered with the BOI as an export producer of banana chips. Rodolfo is one of the three witnesses lined up for Friday’s trial, part of the defense’s efforts to address questions surrounding Cale88, a banana chips manufacturing company linked to Duterte’s […]...
